red.role: THE brand red. Palette page p6, the p8 colourway grid, and the measured value of every application mockup in the book.

light.role: Oversized display copy and metadata captions

module.role: Bar thickness as a fraction of symbol height. The spacing module the source book never defines.

notes: One closed 17-vertex straight-line polygon. No curves anywhere. Verified byte-identical across two independent instances (p8 lockup at 250x110.777pt, p9 construction at 541.21x239.815pt).
Deliberately NOT monoline: diagonals are 6.3% thicker than the horizontal bars (0.1903 vs 0.17903 of height). An equal-weight rebuild reads wrong.
The p5 instance is a hand-squashed defect — every X byte-identical to p4, every Y multiplied by 0.98337, making it 1.66% short. Never trace it.

The five diagonal edges run 32.52-33.40 degrees, a 0.88 degree spread, and the fork is asymmetric. Geometry is frozen exactly as drawn. Regularising to a clean 33.69 degrees (2:3 slope) would mean redrawing the logo — a decision for the brand owner, not this system.
Aspect is locked. Any component API must expose an aspect-locked box, never independent width and height.

control.role: Interactive controls. 0.18-0.22 x control height, measured from the book (~8-10px on a 44px control).

pill.role: RESERVED. The non-interactive eyebrow tag only. Never a button.

circle.role: RESERVED. The floating action button, and the product 'spot' disc.
